rows.note: Profit sent from a Swiss branch to its foreign head office is not a dividend from a domestic payer, so no withholding tax arises; a Swiss subsidiary's dividends bear the 35% withholding tax.
rows.source_title: Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 51 and 68; ESTV Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), sections 2.1.1.2 and 2.2.2

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer and the imputed rental value reform
rows.label: Federal level
rows.value: None: the Confederation levies no property tax and the tax harmonisation act has no rules on it
rows.note: The property tax is separate from the cantonal wealth tax (which allows debts to be deducted) and from the property gains tax on sales.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.11 Liegenschaftssteuer

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer and the imputed rental value reform
rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: Mainly municipalities: in every municipality of SG, TI, VS and JU; optionally in BE, OW, FR, AI, GR and VD; the canton only in TG and GE; TI and VS also tax legal entities' real estate at cantonal level; NE taxes investment property
rows.note: The property tax is separate from the cantonal wealth tax (which allows debts to be deducted) and from the property gains tax on sales.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.11 Liegenschaftssteuer

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer and the imputed rental value reform
rows.label: Base
rows.value: The gross value of the real estate (market, income or cadastral value), without deducting debts; levied where the property lies
rows.note: The property tax is separate from the cantonal wealth tax (which allows debts to be deducted) and from the property gains tax on sales.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.11 Liegenschaftssteuer

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer and the imputed rental value reform
rows.label: Rate range
rows.value: Proportional, from 0.1 per mille to 3 per mille of the property value
rows.note: The property tax is separate from the cantonal wealth tax (which allows debts to be deducted) and from the property gains tax on sales.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.11 Liegenschaftssteuer

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer and the imputed rental value reform
rows.label: Cantons without a property tax
rows.value: ZH, SZ, GL, ZG, SO, BL and AG; several cantons (LU, OW, NW, BS, SH, AR, TG, TI) levy a minimum tax on legal entities' real estate instead of profit and capital tax where it is higher
rows.note: The property tax is separate from the cantonal wealth tax (which allows debts to be deducted) and from the property gains tax on sales.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.11 Liegenschaftssteuer

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer and the imputed rental value reform
rows.label: Each canton's rules
rows.value: On the canton pages; ESTV Steuermäppchen 'Liegenschaftssteuer' (https://www.estv2.admin.ch/stp/sm/liegenschaftssteuern-de-fr.pdf)
rows.note: The property tax is separate from the cantonal wealth tax (which allows debts to be deducted) and from the property gains tax on sales.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.11 Liegenschaftssteuer

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer and the imputed rental value reform
rows.label: Imputed rental value (Eigenmietwert)
rows.value: Still taxed in 2026: owner-occupiers add the imputed rent of their home to taxable income and may deduct maintenance costs and debt interest
rows.note: The property tax is separate from the cantonal wealth tax (which allows debts to be deducted) and from the property gains tax on sales.
rows.source_title: Der Bundesrat: Bundesrat setzt Abschaffung des Eigenmietwerts auf 2029 in Kraft (press release, 1 April 2026); ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Besteuerung der Eigenmietwerte (2026)

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer and the imputed rental value reform
rows.label: Imputed rental value reform: vote
rows.value: Approved by the people on 28 September 2025 (57.7% yes): the constitutional amendment on cantonal property taxes on second homes, linked to the federal act on the change of system
rows.note: The property tax is separate from the cantonal wealth tax (which allows debts to be deducted) and from the property gains tax on sales.
rows.source_title: Der Bundesrat: Bundesrat setzt Abschaffung des Eigenmietwerts auf 2029 in Kraft (press release, 1 April 2026); ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Besteuerung der Eigenmietwerte (2026)

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer and the imputed rental value reform
rows.label: Imputed rental value reform: start date
rows.value: Decided, not yet in force: the Federal Council set the entry into force for 1 January 2029 (decision of 1 April 2026); from then imputed rent on owner-occupied homes is no longer taxed, the maintenance-cost deduction for them ends, debt interest is deductible only in proportion to let property, and cantons may levy a special property tax on mainly owner-used second homes
rows.note: The property tax is separate from the cantonal wealth tax (which allows debts to be deducted) and from the property gains tax on sales.
rows.source_title: Der Bundesrat: Bundesrat setzt Abschaffung des Eigenmietwerts auf 2029 in Kraft (press release, 1 April 2026); ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Besteuerung der Eigenmietwerte (2026)

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer
rows.label: Federal level
rows.value: None: transfer taxes are cantonal or communal
rows.note: Reliefs exist in some cantons for family transfers, main residences and business restructurings (see the canton pages).
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.12 Handänderungssteuer

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer
rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: Usually the canton; a municipal tax in AR, SG and GR; in FR, VD and VS the municipalities can add their own
rows.note: Reliefs exist in some cantons for family transfers, main residences and business restructurings (see the canton pages).
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.12 Handänderungssteuer

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer
rows.label: Cantons with no transfer tax as such
rows.value: ZH, UR, SZ, GL, ZG, SH, AG and TI charge only land registry or transfer fees
rows.note: Reliefs exist in some cantons for family transfers, main residences and business restructurings (see the canton pages).
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.12 Handänderungssteuer

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer
rows.label: Base and payer
rows.value: Usually the purchase price; paid by the buyer unless agreed otherwise; in OW, BL and AR buyer and seller usually pay half each
rows.note: Reliefs exist in some cantons for family transfers, main residences and business restructurings (see the canton pages).
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.12 Handänderungssteuer

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer
rows.label: Rate range
rows.value: Usually a fixed rate between 1% and 3.3% of the purchase price
rows.note: Reliefs exist in some cantons for family transfers, main residences and business restructurings (see the canton pages).
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.12 Handänderungssteuer

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer
rows.label: Rates stored on the canton pages
rows.value: From 1% to 3% in the cantons whose current law was read; Graubünden, Neuchâtel, Geneva and Jura are awaiting a re-read
rows.note: Reliefs exist in some cantons for family transfers, main residences and business restructurings (see the canton pages).
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.12 Handänderungssteuer

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer
rows.label: Foreign buyers
rows.value: No transfer-tax surcharge; purchases of Swiss real estate by persons abroad need a permit under the federal Lex Koller (not a tax)
rows.note: Reliefs exist in some cantons for family transfers, main residences and business restructurings (see the canton pages).
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.12 Handänderungssteuer

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Corporate tax (Gewinnsteuer) [federal, cantonal and communal]
rows.value: federal 8.5% of net profit (4.25% for associations and foundations); cantonal and communal profit tax set by each canton; 15% OECD minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000 (QDMTT since 2024, IIR since 2025). Paid by companies, cooperatives and other legal entities with seat, management or a permanent establishment in Switzerland. DBG art. 68 and 71; cantonal tax laws; MindStV of 22 December 2023.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 59, 68, 69 and 71; ESTV Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.1.1.2

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Tax on branch profits and distributed profits [federal]
rows.value: branch profits: profit tax at the normal rates, no separate branch tax; dividends and interest: 35% withholding tax (Verrechnungssteuer). Paid by the Swiss payer withholds it from the shareholder or creditor. DBG art. 51; Bundesgesetz über die Verrechnungssteuer (VStG).
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.2.2 Verrechnungssteuer

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Self-employed contributions: AHV/IV/EO [federal]
rows.value: 10% of earned income from CHF 60,500, sliding scale from 5.371% below that, minimum CHF 530 a year, no ceiling; plus up to 5% administrative costs and the cantonal family-allowance contribution. Paid by self-employed people (through their AHV compensation fund). AHVG; IVG; EOG; AHV leaflet 2.02.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: Informationsstelle AHV/IV: Merkblatt 2.02 Beiträge der Selbstständigerwerbenden an die AHV, die IV und die EO (Stand am 1. Januar 2026)

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Contractor or employee: AHV status test [federal]
rows.value: the AHV compensation fund decides on the economic facts (own business risk, independence); no withholding on payments to resident contractors; federal withholding on fees to non-resident artists, athletes and speakers (0.8% to 7%) and board members (5%). Paid by clients who engage workers (AHV contributions where the work is employment). AHVG art. 5 and 9; BSV Wegleitung über den massgebenden Lohn; DBG art. 92 and 93.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: Informationsstelle AHV/IV: Merkblatt 2.02 (Stand am 1. Januar 2026); BSV: Wegleitung über den massgebenden Lohn in der AHV, IV und EO (WML), Stand 1. Mai 2026, Rz 1013-1019

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Simplified regimes: VAT net tax rate method and simplified settlement [federal]
rows.value: no simplified income tax; VAT registration from CHF 100,000 turnover; net tax rate method up to CHF 5,024,000 turnover and CHF 108,000 VAT a year; 5% flat tax in the simplified settlement procedure for small wages. Paid by businesses that opt in. MWSTG art. 10 and 37; DBG art. 37a; Bundesgesetz gegen die Schwarzarbeit (BGSA).
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: Fedlex: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG, SR 641.20), Stand am 1. Januar 2024, Art. 37; ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 2.2.1

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (Quellensteuer) [federal, cantonal and communal]
rows.value: withheld by the employer at the canton's tariff; ordinary assessment on request for quasi-residents (at least 90% of worldwide income taxed in Switzerland); German commuters at most 4.5%; Italian new commuters 80% of the tariff. Paid by non-resident employees and foreign residents without a C permit (withheld by the employer). DBG art. 83-101; QStV; StHG art. 32-38; tax treaties and cross-border agreements.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: Fedlex: Bundesgesetz über die direkte Bundessteuer (DBG, SR 642.11), Stand am 2. September 2026, Art. 83, 91 and 99a; Fedlex: Quellensteuerverordnung des EFD (QStV, SR 642.118.2), Stand am 10. Januar 2025, Art. 1 and 14

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer) [cantonal or communal]
rows.value: in about half the cantons, mostly communal, 0.1 per mille to 3 per mille of the gross property value; none in ZH, SZ, GL, ZG, SO, BL and AG; imputed rental value abolished from 1 January 2029 (vote of 28 September 2025). Paid by property owners. cantonal tax laws and municipal tax regulations.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026), section 3.1.11 Liegenschaftssteuer

rows.section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
rows.label: Property transfer tax (Handänderungssteuer) [cantonal or communal]
rows.value: usually 1% to 3.3% of the purchase price; none as such in ZH, UR, SZ, GL, ZG, SH, AG and TI (fees only). Paid by the buyer unless agreed otherwise (half each in OW, BL and AR). cantonal transfer tax laws.
rows.note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax and social insurance are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
